headline: Iraq's oil between faction influence and lifelines
summary: Amid suspicions of oil smuggling in Jurf al-Sakhar, tensions between the government and armed factions, and a halt of gas at the Khor Mor field, Baghdad is seeking to protect its resources and export routes.
why: Iraq is one of the largest oil producers in OPEC, so disruptions to its export routes and gas output affect regional energy supply.
